metric_definitions.assigned_precision: Correct assigned Topic labels divided by all assigned Topic labels on single-label, context, and should-DEFER cases; multi-label reported separately.
metric_definitions.auto_assignment_coverage: Single-label cases with at least one auto-assigned Topic divided by all 288 single-label cases, irrespective of correctness.
metric_definitions.topic_macro_recall: Arithmetic mean over 144 Topics of correctly assigned single-label cases divided by the two gold cases for that Topic.
metric_definitions.insufficient_evidence_false_assignment: Should-DEFER cases with any assigned Topic divided by all should-DEFER cases.
metric_definitions.context_harm_events: Context cases with an incorrect assigned Topic, including assignment where gold is DEFER.
metric_definitions.multi_label: Reported separately and excluded from the single-label macro-recall denominator.
metric_definitions.deterministic_repeat: Compare two outputs per case within one frozen evaluation invocation without changing runtime or policy.
